newsitem.title: CHINA: China Qinhuangdao power plant starts up new unit.
newsitem.headline: China Qinhuangdao power plant starts up new unit.

text.p: A new unit of the Qinhuangdao thermal power plant in China's northern province of Hebei has started operation after a 168-hour trial period, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Unit Four of the plant recorded no technical errors during the trial, it said.

The first two phases of the 3.4 billion yuan ($409.6 million) project had been completed, with annual output capacity of 6.8 billion kilowatt-hours of electricity and installed capacity of 100,000 megawatts, the agency said.
The North China Electricity Co and the Hebei Construction Investment Corp established the Qinhuangdao plant, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
